title: Private-Server HTTP Startup Contract - Recovered Evidence Inventory
method: IDA static-analysis workflow; pefile string extraction (idat batch/headless unavailable - error code 2; ida.exe batch produced no output)

payload_encoding_evidence.field_extraction_string: ACPP_UserDataCheckMain::HttpGameDataLoad / IsSuccess[%d] / PlayerData Name[%s] NesysID[%s] PlayerID[%d] CharacterCustomize.Num(%d) GameMode[%s](%d) BuddyId[%s](%d)
payload_encoding_evidence.protobuf_scoping: message.pb.cpp is the TCP protocol; protobuf fields do not apply to HTTP startup

startup_ordering.implication: Boot progression is gated on HTTP request completion with a wait timer; a stalled/unanswered startup HTTP request blocks boot until timeout.

binding_inventory.note: BindHttp<Name> are callback-binding function names (route intent). They do NOT encode the URL path, HTTP method, or JSON payload contract. A subset is: FestEntry, FestResult, GachaDraw, InfoNewItems, MechaRegister, ShopBuy/ShopSave, QuestStatusSet, QuestsLoad, Ranking*/Ranging*, GreetingLoginSave, BuddyPresentGive, PlayerEntryName, BattleRecord, Tutorial*.

determination.reason: G20 implementation rule requires confirmed route path + HTTP method + request message type + response message type + fields + client success condition + client state effect for each route. Only 2 literal paths are recovered; methods and JSON payload contracts are not confirmed for any startup route. Fabrication is forbidden. All routes documented as blocked.
determination.transport_note: HTTP payload is JSON; protobuf field-number derivation from declaration order does not apply and must not be attempted.
